messages:
Sam (CSM): Quick flag  Orchid Systems daily embed/generation volume dropped ~45% since Mon after procurement started a cost bakeoff with CompetitorLite. Renewal talk in 6w. Need triage; they care about per-embedding cost and deterministic batch throughput.
Rory (AM): Got it. Any churn?
Sam (CSM): Seats steady, key change is new procurement lead (Harper) pushing price-first shortlist. Link to quick metrics: https://redwood.dash/orchid/summary
```
This week: embeddings 14.2k -> 7.9k/day
gen jobs: 3.1k -> 2.2k/day
Top cost: embeddings (62%)
```
Dee (Solutions Eng): Any latency or error regressions?
Sam (CSM): No. They ran a batch accuracy check and found a small semantic drift on one template; procurement flagged it as a quality risk but said cost is the dominant factor.
Ivy (RevOps): I can produce a side-by-side: baseline hosted vs optimized reserved + batching + quant profile vs CompetitorLite quote. If we can show ~22% TCO improvement with our config + a 2-week pilot, that's persuasive. I have draft numbers by 4pm PT.
Rory (AM): Can we offer a pilot w/ reserved burst and observability included? If yes, draft terms.
Dee (Solutions Eng): Technically feasible: enable prefix caching for their common queries, increase batch window for nightly pipelines, and use int8 quant for the embed model. Risks: int8 could slightly change nearest-neighbor distances; we'll add a small post-embed calibration step to normalize vectors. I'll run before/after token and embed-distance diffs and a perf snapshot. ETA 3:30pm PT.
infra-bot: [provision] reserved-pool orchid-reserve-sprint created by dee at 2024-08-21T15:12:02Z
Ivy (RevOps): Quick delta (rough): baseline $0.028/embed -> optimized $0.021/embed (~25% lower). CompetitorLite quoted $0.018/embed but no SLAs and exports only. Posting CSV in drive.
Rory (AM): Actions:
- Dee: technical run + embed-quality diffs (3:30pm)
- Ivy: detailed TCO + contract clause for renewal (4pm)
- Sam: collect repro for the semantic drift, ask Harper for their acceptance criteria and any evaluation scripts (EOD)
- Rory: draft 2-week pilot offer + executive note (by TOM)
Any blockers?
Dee (Solutions Eng): None. Will flag any calibration caveats.
Sam (CSM): One ask  if we can pair the pilot with a small credit to offset switching friction, it helps. Rory, you good owning that?
Rory (AM): Yes. I'll propose a 10% first-month credit and waived onboarding for the pilot. Legal ping when Ivy posts the contract excerpt.
Sam (CSM): Thanks all. I'll update once Dee posts the embed diffs. :thumbsup:
